title: PlantUML Viewer & Preview
description: PlantUML viewer and live preview for VS Code, drawn on your computer by the bundled PlantUML jar: .puml files and plantuml blocks in Markdown, zoom and pan, save as SVG or PNG, no server and no Graphviz needed. Needs Java 11+.

title: Nginx Config Formatter & Lint
description: Nginx config formatter and lint for VS Code: correct syntax colours, a formatter that never breaks a valid file, checks with quick fixes, hover help for every common directive, completion, outline and a server overview across include files. No network.

title: clang extern rw map
description: Shows, for an extern variable, which files write it and which files read it, as an arrow diagram plus a jump-to line list.

title: SplaySpace: Live Collaborative Coding
description: Share projects in VS Code. Edit together, sync files and see where teammates are working.

title: Bíblia (biblia-cli)
description: Bible verses in several translations, with the original Hebrew/Greek, Strong's numbers, dictionary senses and parallel passages — through the biblia command-line tool. Versículos em várias traduções, original, Strong e paralelos.

title: CocoVS
description: Coco-de-Mer assembly, local emulation and custom processor projects

title: SFTP & FTP Sync and Upload
description: SFTP and FTP upload for VS Code: upload on save, upload and download files and folders over SFTP, FTP and FTPS, and a remote file explorer whose files open and save in place. Secrets and .vscode never uploaded. No account.
